note.zh-TW: 部分課程公式以 TR 代表營業收入；它指本期認列的生意，不等於收到的現金。
note.en: Some course formulas write it as TR; it means the business recognised in the period, not the cash received.

definition.zh-TW: 本期賣出商品或提供服務所認列的金額，也就是這段期間做成的生意。它不等於收到的現金：賒銷也算收入。
definition.en: The amount recognised for goods sold or services provided in the period, in other words the business done. It is not the same as cash received: credit sales count too.
